limitations: Ten manually defined paraphrases of one Boolean condition.
Only one workflow state tested per case.
Each direct method uses one LLM call per decision.
Structured contracts are regenerated each repetition.
Boolean guidance is aligned for the controlled comparison. Prompt wording and output constraints differ.
Methods run sequentially. Order and local system conditions may affect timing.
The structured evidence contains parsed conditions. Direct diagnostics contain the response text printed by each router.
Repeatability measures consistency of edge decisions. Complete workflow paths and persisted execution traces require separate evidence.
